guild.name: Mama Bear's Lair
guild.description: The Lair of Mama Bear Xal and her Sleuth of Bears! What's that?! Follow Variety Streamer mamabear_xal on Twitch and see!

channels.name: lair-bear-waves-n-welcomes
channels.topic: This channel is only to wave to the new members. You can react and wave, but from there, the main talk will happen in the actual chat channels. Thank you!

channels.name: welcome-and-rules-channel
channels.topic: Welcome to the Lair Bear Family! Please read through ALL of this!

channels.name: food-pics-and-dining-out
channels.topic: This is the place to post your pictures of the dishes you cook or the food you get at restaurants that we should all DROOL over!

channels.name: mental-health-discussion
channels.topic: Welcome to the Mental Heath Discussions channel.  This is a safe space for you to share you're good, bad, and ugly news or things are bothering you if you need someone to listen to, or advice, without judgement.  Please remember - **this is a SAFE SPACE**

channels.name: sleuth-announcements
channels.topic: This is a post only channel for ModBears and the Mama Bear herself! Watch this space for important announcements!!

channels.name: the-suggestion-box
channels.topic: Got a channel suggestion? Leave it here! Got a guideline/rule suggestion? Leave it here! Got a bot suggestion for Discord? Leave it here! Anything you want to see or think might be helpful to the stream or the server - let me know!!!

channels.name: get-ta-know-me
channels.topic: This is the channel to introduce yourself and post pic of yourself so everyone can get to know you a bit better! What you share here is up to you, but I suggest just giving us what you're comfortable with us knowing. This is not mandatory, just a courtesy.

channels.name: mama-bears-bulletin-board
channels.topic: A great big cork bulletin board outside of Mama Bear's Office that she can post snippets on and YOU can post snippets on too!

channels.name: mamas-stream-schedule
channels.topic: This is the channel to find Mama's Pre-planned Stream schedule in.

channels.name: mamas-merch-channel
channels.topic: This is the place to find the newest posts for Mama Bear's Merch! This is also the place to post any ideas or requests for items you'd like to see in the Merch Shop as well as any pics you might send Mama of the items you've bought!

channels.name: modbear-chat
channels.topic: A channel JUST for the ModBears! Well... and me. This is where the ModBears can chat and share info with each other on commands, bots, etc. If there's a SUS user in the chat, if you know something about a SUS user, things like that. If you've been to someone else's stream and see a bot or something they're using (Like Frosty Tools) or use one yourself that you'd like me to look into - this is also the place to post it and tell me a bit about it and why I should use it. Thanks and MUCH love to my hard-working ModBears!! <3

channels.name: podcasts-sfwmemes-videos
channels.topic: Got a favorite Podcast, a funny SFW meme or a video from YouTube video you absolutely need to share with the Community? This is the place to post the link to it!

channels.name: stream-tech-help
channels.topic: The place to come if you have questions about getting started with streaming, setting up emotes, or working with streaming tools in general! The Slueth is filled with some very bright minds that can help!

channels.name: gaming-ids-and-igns
channels.topic: This is the place to post your gaming IDs and In Game Names (igns/IGNs) so that others can add you in their favorite games and you can all play together or trade and share things in the game!

channels.name: u-do-tattoos-boo
channels.topic: I see tattoos as self-care because they are a record of your life on our skin most times. Some people find the experience of getting a tattoo rather cathartic as well. And then there's the skin care afterwards that sometimes becomes routine! So this is the place to post about the tattoos you have, the tattoos you want, the tattoos you're getting, and maybe the after-care that you use. And remember - PICS OR IT DIDN"T HAPPEN!

channels.name: bearthday-channel
channels.topic: Put in your BEARthday (with or without year) and we'll all get reminded to celebrate with you every year!!

channels.name: share-your-characters-and-clips
channels.topic: This is the place to show off your characters from any an all games you play! Pics, stats, amazing back stories, whatever you want to share! And you can post clips from your games here too!

channels.name: tell-us-a-joke-nsfw
channels.topic: The place to tell us a joke! 18+ or otherwise, just try to keep it from being TOO gross, please? There's funny and then there's -BARFTASTIC-. And definitely no racist, homophobic, or hateful jokes. Humor is humor but not if it's in the form of hate towards another person.

channels.name: server-activity-channel-modbears-only
channels.topic: This channel is going to let you see all of the member activity to make sure no one's pulling any shady $hit behind our backs. If they post and delete, we'll see it. If they change their name, edit what they said, etc. - we'll see it.

channels.name: mama-and-the-modbears-help
channels.topic: Got an issue in the Lair ya can't solve? How can we help? Welcome to our ticketing channel! This is where you can place a ticket, and the Mama and The ModBears will handle it. If you have an issue, complaint, or problem... a tech issue, a compliment, or or even recognition for someone who went above and beyond! THIS... is the place ya submit it via a ticket.

channels.name: mamas-monthly-free-games
channels.topic: Once a month, at the beginning of the month, Mama Bear gets a bundle of games from Humble Bundle and what she doesn't claim, she's allowed to give the keys away for! This is the place for Mama to post those keys! They're up for grabs and are First-Come-First-Served! Grab em while they're hot!!!

channels.name: mama-bears-po-box-info-only
channels.topic: This channel ONLY contains Mama Bear's P.O. Box Information for easy access. You may only add reactions to the posts here. ModBears may add reactions, Invite people directly in via this channel, and @ tag people in this channel if they need to know where to locate Mama Bear's P.O. Pox Info.

channels.name: lair-bear-receipe-stash
channels.topic:
Mama Bear brings you a very special channel to post and share recipes in! It's our very own virtual cookbook for the Lair Bear Family!!
     This channel is for posting RECIPES ONLY! If you cook a recipe, you can post a picture of it in here, but please be sure you tag the recipe you cooked so we know which one it is!!! If it's not a recipe, about one of the recipes, or a pic of a recipe that you've cooked - it WILL get deleted. Fair warning.

channels.name: the-bear-dictionary
channels.topic: words are hard, so here are our alternatives!

channels.name: your-mama-bear-fan-art
channels.topic: That's right! Wanna draw Mama Bear? Or maybe one of your favorite ModBears?! Maybe you've written a song or a poem about Mama?! THIS is the place to toss those amazing works of creative genius!!! Whether it's just a little something or a full blown masterpiece - put em up here and we'll love them like there's no tomorrow! PROMISE!!

channels.name: 🐻hey-mama-bear🐻
channels.topic: **HEY, MAMA BEAR!!** Got somethin' ya wanna tell Mama? Wanna get Mama's attention to ask her a direct question? Maybe ask if you can DM her (ya know, all polite like)? Maybe you just wanna tell her something GREAT you've done! Or even something silly you've done! Maybe ya just wanna tell her ya love her. Whatever the reason, this channel is ALL about sending messages to Mama that can start out with - "Hey, Mama Bear!" or "Hey, Mama Bear?" - whatever the case may be. And in here, you can use @mamabear_xal as much as you want (WITHIN REASON) without the @Modbears getting on your case about it. You have permission from Mama herself! So, g'won! Tell Mama somethin' today!!!

channels.name: twitchcon-2026-info
channels.topic: Things pertaining to TwitchCon 2026 in San Diego, California, November 13th, 14th, and 15th, will be posted in this channel. Keep an eye out in here for any important information!

channels.name: 🎮whos-streaming-now
channels.topic: This is the channel that will shout out those streamers in The Sleuth and friends of Mama Bear when they go live, letting you know via Discord notification. This will be a ROLE ONLY channel! If you want to be notified when this channel is pinged as someone goes live, let Mama Bear Xal or one of the ModBears know to add the ***@Notify Me*** role to your account and from then on you'll get the notifications when someone goes live so you can jump in on the fun! Thanks!!

channels.name: self-promotion-and-shoutouts
channels.topic: This channel is for Streamers who ALREADY HAVE AFFILIATE and need to shout themselves out. Or if you have someone you need to shout out who HAS AFFILIATE and we should check out as a potential member of the Lair. ** IF YOU HAVE AN AUTO-SHOUTY ALREADY IN THE #whos-streaming-now CHANNEL, PLEASE DO NOT REPOST HERE! PLEASE CHECK THE LIST FOR YOUR NAME IN THE MESSAGE PINNED AT THE TOP OF THE #whos-streaming-now CHANNEL BEFORE POSTING!! I'm doing my best to get people added ASAP so you're auto-shouted out as soon as you go Live on Twitch and don't have yet another channel to post in! ;)**

channels.name: reaching-for-affiliate-streamers
channels.topic: IF YOU NEED AFFILIATE STILL - PLEASE POST YOUR STREAMS IN HERE SO THAT WE CAN DEFINITELY GET YOU OUR FAMILY SUPPORT TO MEET THOSE FOLLOWER AND VIEWERSHIP GOALS YOU NEED!!! Also, if you know of someone who would be a great fit for the family who also needs affiliate, shout them out here and then have them join the discord, please!

channels.name: 🐻mama-bear-is-live
channels.topic: That's right! Any notifications coming up in here mean that Mama Bear Xal has gone live on Twitch an ya better get'cher ass over there to watch or you'll miss out on all the fun!! G'won now! GIT! (This is a ROLE ONLY channel! If you want this channel to notify you when Mama Bear streams, ask Mama Bear or one of the ModBears to add the @MBLive role to your account) Thanks!

channels.name: twitchcon-2026-headcount
channels.topic: Are you going to TwitchCon 2026?!?! THIS is the place to let us know so Mama Bear can keep a headcount for making plans for an official TwitchCon group meetup as well ad an after hours meetup!!

channels.name: fundraising-and-gofundmes
channels.topic: This channel is STRICTLY an ASK MAMA BEAR OR AN @MODBEAR/@LEAD MODBEAR BEFORE POSTING channel, please. If you post in here before doing so, your post ***__WILL__*** be deleted. If you are fundraising for a charity or have a GoFundMe for yourself or someone else, please contact Mama Bear or a @modbear/@lead modbear before posting in here and we will speak with you about it to give permission. Thank you.
